title: A floral memory block with an open upper margin
description: Imagine a memory-art concept where flowers gather lower in the composition and a clear-looking margin remains above.

sections.heading: The imagined brief
paragraphs: Imagine a memory-art concept where flowers gather lower in the composition and a clear-looking margin remains above. The study explores visual breathing room without representing anyone's actual flowers.

sections.heading: A proposed design response
paragraphs: Compare the margin with the floral density in two sketches. Keep original-material suitability, permanence and exact appearance explicitly unresolved.
